heroDescription: Media coverage and official announcements from the Bluffline.
boilerplate: Bluffline, Inc. is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization advancing a 20-mile multimodal corridor connecting the University of West Florida to Naval Air Station Pensacola. Through its Corridor Management Committee, the Bluffline stewards the Pensacola Scenic Bluffs Scenic Highway designation while building safe, connected infrastructure for walking, cycling, and water transit that will reconnect communities to Pensacola's waterfront.
ctaDescription: Help us build the infrastructure that will transform how Pensacola moves, plays, and connects.
